newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares climb in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares climb in moderate trade.

text.p: The index on the United Arab Emirates' unofficial stock market climbed 10.79 points in moderate trade in the week to Thursday, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) index rose to 2,513.53 points from 2,502.84 the previous week.
Market leader Etisalat, the UAE's telecommunications company, chalked up five dirhams to end the week at 955.
The National Dredging Co firmed to 395 dirhams from 390.

The Abu Dhabi National Hotels Co rose to 1,070 from 1,065 dirhams as demand increased ahead of its annual general meeting (AGM) and expectations rose of the distribution of dividends and bonus shares.
Abu Dhabi Aviation also rose five dirhams to 670 dirhams ahead of its AGM and expectations of dividends.
Al-Ain Al-Ahlia Insurance was unchanged at 940 dirhams and Al-Dhafra insurance remained at 860 dirhams.
The Abu Dhabi Shipbuilding Company dipped to 41 from 43 dirhams and Dubai Investment Co rose to 13.75 from 13.50 dirhams.
Oman and Emirates Investment Co rose from 17 to 18 dirhams and the National Bank of Abu Dhabi rose to 500 from 495 dirhams. -- Dubai newsroom +9714-6071-222
